origin:
Manthey EMA's story is one forged in the crucible of the Nürburgring. Founded in 1996 by Olaf Manthey, initially the team was a small outfit focused primarily on Porsche customer racing and track day events. Manthey, a talented racer himself, saw an opportunity to elevate the performance of Porsche machinery for discerning enthusiasts. The early years were characterized by relentless testing and development on the demanding Nordschleife, a proving ground that would become synonymous with the Manthey name.

The team's turning point came with their increasing success in the VLN endurance series and the 24 Hours Nürburgring. The development of the 'Grello' Porsche 911 GT3 R, with its distinctive green and yellow livery, became an icon of the Nürburgring. The partnership with EMA Motorsport in 2021 further solidified their ambitions, bringing additional resources and expertise to bear on their racing programs, allowing them to compete at the highest levels of GT racing.
philosophy: Manthey EMA's racing philosophy is deeply rooted in meticulous preparation, relentless optimization, and a driver-centric approach. They believe in creating a supportive and collaborative environment where engineers and drivers work in perfect harmony to extract the maximum performance from the car. Car development is an iterative process, with constant data analysis and refinement to improve performance and reliability. The team culture emphasizes a relentless pursuit of excellence, fostering a competitive spirit tempered by respect and sportsmanship.
achievements: Multiple overall victories in the 24 Hours Nürburgring (2006, 2007, 2008, 2009, 2011, 2018, 2021, 2023)
Podium finishes in various international GT racing series, including the Intercontinental GT Challenge
Successful customer racing programs with Porsche machinery
Development of the iconic 'Grello' Porsche 911 GT3 R

teamPrincipal.name: Nicolas Raeder
teamPrincipal.background: Nicolas Raeder is a highly experienced motorsport manager with a proven track record in GT racing. He is known for his calm demeanor, strategic thinking, and ability to motivate the team to perform at their best.

keyFigures.name: Olaf Manthey
keyFigures.description: Olaf Manthey is the founder of the team and a legendary figure in German motorsport. He provides invaluable experience and guidance to the team, drawing on his extensive racing background.

keyFigures.name: Patrick Arkenau
keyFigures.description: Patrick Arkenau is the mastermind behind Manthey EMA's technical success. He is responsible for overseeing all aspects of car development and engineering.

headquarters: Manthey EMA is based near the Nürburgring in Germany. Their facilities, while functional, are primarily focused on practical race preparation and car maintenance, reflecting their hands-on approach to racing.
fanBase: Manthey EMA enjoys a passionate and dedicated fan base, particularly among German motorsport enthusiasts. Their iconic 'Grello' livery is instantly recognizable and has become a symbol of success and innovation at the Nürburgring. The team actively engages with fans through social media and at race events, fostering a strong sense of community.
